summary: 3rd-year Electronics and Communication Engineering student at Istanbul Technical University building ML/AI systems: real-time UAV perception (YOLOv8, RAFT/EKF visual odometry) as Team Captain for TEKNOFEST Havacılıkta Yapay Zeka, and two-stage LightGBM forecasting of intermittent demand for a 20K+ SKU spare-parts catalogue. Focused on real-time inference, model evaluation, and performance optimization, with monitoring and production-readiness experience.

highlights: Served as Team Captain for the TEKNOFEST Havacılıkta Yapay Zeka (AI in Aviation) Competition, defining the system architecture and coordinating the object-detection, position-estimation, and reference-object-matching workstreams.

Designed a hybrid visual odometry pipeline combining ORB/optical flow and RAFT-based motion estimation with confidence-aware arbitration and iterative EKF fusion, achieving approximately 7.5 FPS on custom drone footage.
Built an RGB/thermal aerial reference-object matching pipeline and fine-tuned YOLOv8 over seven training rounds to reach 0.749 mAP50 at approximately 36 ms per frame inference.
Led the four-class UAV object-detection subsystem, including dataset architecture, training strategy, and validation criteria, on a dataset containing more than 35K images.
Designed the competition's unified real-time client, integrating the three subsystems behind a modular inference pipeline with a competition-compliant JSON submission format.
Built an intermittent-demand forecasting system for a 20K+ SKU spare-parts catalogue with approximately 1.4M transaction lines and 94% zero cells at daily grain.
Improved forecast accuracy from 14% to approximately 55% across 26 benchmarked variants, reducing WAPE to 0.543 from a 0.628 last-year baseline.
Designed a two-stage LightGBM hurdle architecture for demand occurrence and non-zero quantity, with SBC-adaptive thresholds and leakage-safe recursive multi-step inference.
Engineered approximately 25 features, including Croston, ADI/CV², rolling and lag windows, and zero-run streaks; used Numba JIT, cutoff-masked feature generation, and fold-local SBC labels.
Built evaluation and monitoring infrastructure with monthly vintage fact tables, FastAPI, Grafana dashboards, restatement detection, and champion/challenger shadow evaluation.

Optimized the multi-model pipeline with joblib process parallelism, float32 downcasting, vectorized rank/correlation computation, and O(1) lookup maps replacing O(P) scans, with parity tests preserving output.
Audited production readiness across backups, migrations, deployment, health checks, testing, dependency consistency, and the repository's handling of secrets and large artifacts.
Developing a phased, test-gated improvement plan covering reliable backups, migration recovery, deployment rollback, meaningful readiness checks, CI testing, and observability.
Analyzed synchronous API workflows that block a single-worker API for 4–65 seconds per file; scoped worker/queue-based execution and measurement as performance priorities.
Documented repository and service refactoring priorities, keeping behavior-changing work separate from hygiene and structural improvements.

Built an end-to-end cross-sell propensity pipeline in KNIME with period-aware data-quality screening, rolling quantile binning against the previous month's breakpoints, and target-preserving category consolidation.
Benchmarked decision tree, GBM, and WoE-based logistic regression under forward/backward feature selection and Gini elimination, evaluated across separate time windows.

Developed a loss-adjuster amount regression under strict leakage control using time-ordered splits and train-only imputation; handled a heavily right-skewed target via log transformation, reducing skewness from 5.45 to 0.26, and evaluated Tweedie, Gamma, Poisson, and two-stage hurdle architectures.

Componentized the pipeline into a single parameter-driven run generalizable to new datasets and authored internal reports on workflow automation tooling, including n8n and KNIME Business Hub, covering KVKK, access control, and deployment.

projects: Bilirkişi — Auditable AI Analytics Platform: Designed a two-plane analytics architecture that separates LLM-assisted reasoning from deterministic execution, keeping numerical calculations, validation, and decisions reproducible. Implemented provenance controls, including data-quality gates, typed contracts, deterministic command execution, structured fact references, and hash-based audit evidence for analytical results.

SketchMind — Multimodal AI, Mobile, and Embedded Companion System: Built a Flutter application integrating AI-assisted storytelling, speech interfaces, Firebase services, and a server-side proxy that keeps API credentials out of the client. Designed real-time mobile-to-ESP32 companion communication through mDNS discovery and WebSockets, supported by firmware, a local simulator, and automated tests.
